observations: The frozen CSV was staged byte-for-byte and its SHA-256 matched the case fixture, but the model did not inspect it.
The model created index.html, styles.css, script.js and data.json as zero-byte files. Browser inspection confirmed an entirely blank page with zero body text.
The model then asked the user to supply numbers or a data URL, so it answered none of the four turns and delivered no comparison download.
Ten successful OpenRouter calls resolved to qwen/qwen3.5-9b across Together and Venice. Provider time was 66.525 seconds, total run time 78.378 seconds, and cost was USD 0.00926785.
evidence_notes: A prior no-input launch is retained separately as diagnostic-setup-error-no-input-excluded and is not counted.
This rep-01 is the first valid measured 9B case and includes staged-input.sha256, raw ACP events, provider audit log, deterministic checks and an opened-page screenshot.
